quests.title: Gourmet Supremos, Assemble!

dialogue.t: （test）看来那本游记里记录的事都是真的，太好了…
（test）总算可以吃到好吃的了，谢谢你啦，旅行者。
Parvaneh, is there really no other way to do this?
My book only mentions this one way.
Heh, if only it was just a bunch of monsters barring our path...

dialogue.sit: Could you repeat that method of yours to me again?

dialogue.t: Eh, allow me. Basically, you need to search for something nearby known as a Thunder Sakura Bough and touch it.
After that, something known as an Electrogranum will attach itself to you, and that will allow you to pass through the barrier.
Parvaneh, is there really no other way to do this?
My book only mentions this one way.
Heh, if only it was just a bunch of monsters barring our path...

dialogue.sit: Are these the Sakura Blooms you've been looking for?

dialogue.t: Ah! Yes, that they are! And this color...
Woohoo! Guess we can finally eat now!
Wait, you've already passed through that barrier? Did you use the method I told you about?
Could you tell me where you found that Thunder Sakura Bough?
When you touched that Bough, how did the Electrogranum come to rest upon you?
...Wait, I'm sorry, let me pull out my notebook. So, did you feel anything after the Electrogranum attached itself to you? And...
Parvaneh, please, give this Traveler a moment. They just helped us out... I think your research can wait a bit, right?
Thank you very much, Traveler. As we agreed, you will be paid.
But before that, just wait here with us for a while. I believe I'll be able to make a dish with the Sakura Blooms you brought.
I've heard of an Inazuman specialty known as Sakura Tempura. I suppose now's the time to try it out.
Give me a while to prepare. It shouldn't take too long, so come find me in a moment.
It goes like this... and this...
Just hold on a moment... wrap it up in flour, put it in to dry...
And there we go! Sakura Tempura — try it while it's hot!
I—It's delicious! ... If a bit too hot...
Xudong, I believe that this "tempura" also needs to be served with a special dipping sauce...
A dipping sauce? Well, I must say that I haven't prepared one of those yet. I'll look into it next time should we get the chance.
This serving of Sakura Tempura is yours, Traveler. Please take it as thanks for your help.
Ah yes, I'll give you a copy of the recipe too. Just give me a moment to write it down...
Try it yourself if you get the chance! Cooking is really fun, you know?

dialogue.sit: Where will you all be going next?

dialogue.t: Don't mention it!
We'll be in Inazuma for a while, so I suspect that we might head to <color=#00E1FFFF>Kannazuka</color> later.
Julie says that she also wants to see that Sacred Sakura Tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.
They say that all the Sakura Blooms on this island fell from that huge tree.
I wonder, how large must that tree have been to have so many leaves fall from it...
You should pay it a visit if it takes your fancy, too.
Thank you for your help once again, Traveler. Well, I'm going to have a bite too. I'm starving...
Amazing, so the travelogue was correct about all this after all.
Looks like we'll get to have some good grub after all! Thanks, Traveler!

quests.description: You meet an odd bunch of people out in Inazuma’s wilds…
